name: queue_source
description: A source that OWNS its own deep work queue (a std::deque of pending items) and paces its emits off the core lane's back-pressure — the exemplar for 'plugin owns the queue' (doc 24). Starts IDLE; exchange 'start' fills the backlog and spins a DEDICATED emit thread that releases one item at a time via emit(); on a queue_depth:0 lane it blocks in the rendezvous until a worker TAKES it, on a queue_depth:1 lane it runs one ahead. exchange 'stop' halts + joins. get_def reports 'emitted', 'backlog', and the run-ahead tells 'first_gap_ms'/'min_gap_ms'/'fast_returns'.
